'''Pinae Wettan''' was the caretaker of [[Quekka Trench Station]]. He was elderly and decided to supplement his income by renting out space in the storage pod to [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who were looking for a place to store their goods. He was very cautious and would not let more than one party on the station at the time to avoid being caught up in conflicts.<ref name="H&S" />
